items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, both Monk and Dizzy would be playing.

ctx.x: Yeah, both Monk and Dizzy would be playing. Way after hours; you know, you can't play loud.

Actually, to me that's a misnomer. Those were sounds that in the act of playing you automatically utter, I suppose. But harmonically and musically, it's very sound. I mean, the figurations that they were playing and the interpretation was a good interpretation, you know. It was very sound music. And I think that putting the name of Bebop I guess maybe appealed to the public. I don't know how it came out. I mean, to me it's like a misnomer. I think it should have a more dignified name, but it is good playing…
